datasets.name: ArabSign
datasets.version_or_subset: RGB modality of the full release: 50 sentences by 6 signers, at least 30 takes per sentence per signer, 9,330 mp4 files verified in the six archives. Entry paths encode signer/split/sentenceID/signer_sentence_(timestamp)_c.mp4, so sample labels come from the path. The target paper runs MediaPipe pose over these colour frames rather than using the Kinect skeleton modality, which is a different estimator (25 joints in 3D camera space versus MediaPipe's 33 landmarks in 2D).
datasets.license_or_permission: No licence is published anywhere for ArabSign. A search on 2026-09-18 found no licence, terms, copyright, permission, consent, ethics, or IRB statement in the dataset paper (arXiv:2210.03951, full text); no LICENSE, COPYING, TERMS, or agreement file among the 60 paths of github.com/Hamzah-Luqman/ArabSign (GitHub API reports "license": null); and no terms on the official project page or on the same author's KArSL page. The archives carry only a citation request in Readme.txt. The "NC only" value in the REPRO-SIGN dataset record is that record's own characterisation, not a published term. The operative basis is therefore the dataset author's direct permission: the assignee contacted Hamzah Luqman (KFUPM), who supplied the official download page https://hamzah-luqman.github.io/ArabSign/ for REPRO-SIGN project use, reported on 2026-09-18. Earlier, the author had provided Team S with the copy transferred on 2026-09-10 that supplied Skeleton and partial Depth. The RGB archives this reproduction added on 2026-09-18 came from the public download links on that same author-published page. The assignee authorised study use and project-cloud processing on that basis. The copy stays private to the repro-sign Modal workspace, no video or frame is redistributed or published, and the requested citation is recorded in reproduction.json.sources.

datasets.known_mismatch: Two documented discrepancies. (1) The RGB modality contains 9,330 videos, five fewer than the 9,335 samples claimed by the ArabSign paper and by Table II of the target paper. The Skeleton modality contains exactly 9,335 .mat files and the four present Depth archives match Skeleton's per-signer counts, so 9,335 is correct for the dataset and the published RGB release is short. RGB is a strict subset of Skeleton with no extra entries. The five absent videos are 01/test/0006/01_0006_(16_02_21_19_36_11)_c, 01/test/0044/01_0044_(20_03_21_20_09_50)_c, 01/train/0020/01_0020_(17_03_21_21_36_28)_c, 02/train/0020/02_0020_(02_03_21_21_01_08)_c, and 05/train/0042/05_0042_(20_03_21_19_25_26)_c. Effective RGB counts are 7,489 train and 1,841 test against Skeleton's 7,492 and 1,843. Transfer integrity is not implicated: every archive matched its source Content-Range byte size exactly. (2) Table II of the target paper labels 200,000 as the total frame count; the ArabSign paper states that figure is for all sentences performed by one signer. The row is copied from reference [19] with the same wrong label.
datasets.paper_preprocessing: MediaPipe pose over colour frames, 33 landmarks with x and y, 10 frames per whole sentence video, giving input (10, 33, 2) and one sample per video labelled by its SentenceID. The frame-selection rule is not published by either paper.

metric_definitions.implementation: Not named. The paper states only that the model is implemented with the Keras API on a TensorFlow backend (§IV).
metric_definitions.aggregation: Overall correct-sample fraction over the held-out split.

metric_definitions.name: Precision
metric_definitions.implementation: Not named. Inferred to be a support-weighted average over the 50 sentence classes; see aggregation.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Inferred support-weighted average over the 50 classes. Table III reports Recall exactly equal to Accuracy in both columns (0.9777 and 0.8875). Support-weighted recall is identically equal to accuracy, whereas macro and micro averaging are not, so the column was very likely produced by weighted averaging. The paper does not state this.

metric_definitions.implementation: Not named. Inferred to be a support-weighted average over the 50 sentence classes; see aggregation.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Inferred support-weighted average over the 50 classes, on the same evidence as precision-weighted. Under this reading the metric is numerically identical to accuracy, which is exactly what Table III shows in both columns.
metric_definitions.unit_or_scale: fraction in [0, 1] as printed in Table III

metric_definitions.aggregation: Inferred support-weighted average over the 50 classes, on the same evidence as precision-weighted. Table III's F1 sits just below accuracy, consistent with weighted averaging.

experiments.system: Proposed temporal-to-spatial residual CNN. MediaPipe pose keypoints for 10 frames per video, 33 landmarks with x and y, giving input shape (10, 33, 2); Conv2D with 32 filters; three residual blocks (32; 64 stride 2; 128 stride 2); flatten; Dense 128; Dense 50. 755,346 parameters. Adam, categorical cross-entropy, batch size 32, 100 epochs; learning rate 0.001 is not stated in the target paper and is carried from reference [19], which §IV says supplied the same training parameters.
experiments.checkpoint_rule: None published. The paper describes a fixed 100-epoch run and reports final-model metrics; no best-checkpoint selection or early stopping is mentioned, and Figure 3(a) shows testing loss rising slightly after about 40 epochs without any action taken.
experiments.paper_evidence: Table III, ResNet column; architecture in §III and Table I; training settings and hardware in §IV.

experiments.system: Prior LSTM system from reference [19]: two stacked LSTM layers of 512 units, then flatten and two dense layers, output 50; 3,835,954 parameters per Table III, matching the "3.8 million parameters" reported in [19] §4. Trained in [19] on an Intel Xeon Silver 4112 with an NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU, unlike this paper's CPU-only runs.
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Not applicable. The values are carried from [19] rather than produced by this reproduction.
experiments.paper_evidence: Table III, LSTM column; [19] §4 architecture and §5 result of 88.75% test accuracy.

gates.reason: ArabSign is colour video of six identifiable signers, and no consent basis is documented anywhere. A search on 2026-09-18 found no consent, ethics, IRB, permission, or terms statement in the dataset paper, no licence or agreement file in its repository, and none on the project page. Access, cloud processing, storage, and reporting are settled: the author granted use for this project, the assignee authorised project-cloud processing, the copy stays private to the repro-sign workspace, and only metrics are reported with no imagery published. The consent basis for the original recording is the one element that cannot be established from published sources, so the assignee has chosen to keep this gate open rather than record a determination.
